_comment: ADR-037 register fragment — export-github-broker. Adds githubCredentialId + requestedBy to the exportJob schema, and NOTHING else (deepMergeConfig recurses into components.schemas.exportJob.properties; exportJob.required and every other property are untouched). Background: the GitHub export used to take the user's Personal Access Token — typed into an Buildiq dialog, POSTed to an Buildiq controller, persisted by Buildiq under ICredentialsManager, and replayed by Buildiq against api.github.com. Encryption at rest did not change the fact that Buildiq was the custodian. Both properties are deliberately NOT secrets and are safe on the record: githubCredentialId is the UUID of a credential in OpenRegister's broker (the token itself lives in the Doriath vault and is injected server-side, so this app can never read it), and requestedBy is a plain Nextcloud UID. requestedBy exists because RunExportJob is a background job with no user session, so the broker's ownership guard has no session identity to check against — the queueing user's UID has to travel on the record. Neither property is required: ExportJobs created before this fragment, and every target=zip job, simply do not have them, and the push path fails closed without a credential.

githubCredentialId.title: GitHub Credential
githubCredentialId.description: UUID of the `github` credential in OpenRegister's credential broker to push with (only when target=github). A reference, never a token: Buildiq sends {method, path, body} plus this UUID to the broker, which checks ownership, the allowed-app grant and the allow-rules, then injects the secret. Buildiq cannot read the secret behind it.

requestedBy.title: Requested By
requestedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the user who queued the export. Carried so the session-less background job can tell the broker which identity owns `githubCredentialId` — the broker's owner/IDOR guard needs an identity, and a cron run has no session to read one from.
